title: Smart Fish Tank
summary: A custom smart fish tank enclosure developed from customer reference images and translated into a printable multi-part prototype.
imageAlt: Full-scale gray smart fish tank enclosure prototype on a wooden surface
challenge: The customer concept needed to become a manufacturable enclosure that could organize the tank, display, lighting, and internal components while remaining practical to assemble.
approach: A multi-part 3D model was developed from the supplied references, separating the housing, lid, base, and internal supports for FDM production and assembly.
result: The completed full-scale prototype brought the concept into physical form and provided a functional platform for evaluating component fit and the overall design.
